_meta.source: MONTAGE M Data List (montage_m_dl_H0.pdf, 'For firmware version 3.01 and later')
notes: index: 1-based order of appearance in the PDF (reading order: left to right, then next page). Not a MIDI parameter.
keys[].note: key name as printed (C0..C6 range in this list; the instrument's key naming has middle C = C3).
keys[].wave_number: preset waveform number (see waveforms.json / MIDI 'Wave Number'). keys[].wave_name: waveform name as printed.
Kit index 153 (PDF page 65, 4th column) has no kit name printed in the PDF (verified visually); name is null.
Some kits do not cover the full C0-C6 range (e.g. 'Highland Snares' C2-G3, several EDM kits B0-A4); keys lists only the printed rows.
